Author: dexcss
Name: Glamour Sorter
Description: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser — outfit sets as outfit glamours (including seasonal sets, with the Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog automated) and loose items one by one — skipping anything already stored. Includes an extractor that withdraws dresser items back to your bags: all loose items, duplicates only, or one item type such as all rings. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
Changelog: v1.3.0.14: Diagnosis + fallback for the seasonal Outfit Glamour Creation stalls — the store step now logs the addon state, hand-in counts and every slot (item id, inventory type, flag), and if no confirmation opens within 2 s it fires the addon's Store as Glamour callback (18) as a fallback. v1.3.0.13: Quality consistency for outfit hand-ins — the outfit window only accepts pieces of one quality ("Only items of the same quality may be selected") and a mixed HQ/NQ selection made the game silently refuse the store while leaving the window open. The plugin now anchors on the quality it holds most of and hands in only pieces of that quality, logging any piece skipped for quality. v1.3.0.12: Checkbox-dialog fix — the confirm ladder now ticks the "Store as Outfit Glamour" checkbox first (synthetic ButtonClick + SetChecked) and fires Yes once the game enables it, instead of firing the default-confirm callback first, which closed the dialog without depositing on several sets (the "checkbox was never selected" symptom). The default-confirm callback is kept as a fallback for dialogs whose Yes cannot be enabled from the checkbox. v1.3.0.11: Cross-set outfit mismatch guard — a glamour piece can belong to more than one outfit set, and the game may open a different set's stored outfit when completing; the plugin now compares the opened outfit's item id with the planned set and skips with "left for manual review" instead of handing the piece into the wrong outfit and reporting a false failure. The store log keeps the dialog mode and prism-box index so any remaining case is diagnosable. v1.3.0.10: Fix the "No deposit detected" failures on outfit completions. The hand-in loop was allowed to target a slot already marked Filled (the outfit already contained that piece), which the game silently refused; it now only hands into Unfilled slots, and a set whose planned pieces are all already inside the outfit reports "Already in the stored outfit — nothing to add" instead of attempting a store. The native StoreExistingOutfit retry from 1.3.0.9 is removed — it returns success but deposits nothing unless the Glamour Creation window drives it. v1.3.0.9: Fix false "No deposit detected" results when completing an outfit — the game's confirm dialog sometimes closes without depositing for outfits that were only just created. After 1.5 s without a change the plugin now sends the same request the dialog sends (StoreExistingOutfit/StoreNewOutfit) once, then re-checks; store logs also report the dialog mode and prism-box index for diagnosis. v1.3.0.8: Withdraw tab clarity — the action buttons now state what they will do and grey out with an explicit empty-state label: "No duplicates to withdraw", "No singles to withdraw", and "No sets to withdraw & re-deposit" when there is nothing to pack (otherwise "Withdraw & re-deposit sets (N)" with counts). The consolidation description now explains the withdraw-then-pack-as-outfit loop and the slot saving. v1.3.0.7: Fix a window render crash when the set-consolidation loop ran with no loose set pieces left to start (the empty candidate list was indexed directly) — it now reports "Nothing to consolidate" instead. The consolidation pump is also exception-guarded so a future error cannot take the whole window down. v1.3.0.6: Set consolidation now runs in bag-sized batches — it withdraws one set's loose pieces (only as many as your free bag slots can hold), stores that set as a single outfit glamour, then repeats automatically. Before this the button tried to withdraw every loose set piece at once (359 items against 63 free slots) and was refused. v1.3.0.5: Dresser-full handling — at 800/800 the store run now stops with a clear 'Glamour Dresser is full' result instead of failing every remaining item with 'no deposit detected'. New "set pieces stored loose" detector on the Withdraw tab: it finds items the dresser stores individually that belong to an outfit set, shows how many pieces/sets and the approximate slots that would be freed, withdraws them (arm-then-confirm), then automatically runs the store pass that packs each set into one outfit glamour. v1.3.0.4: Single-item deposits now work — loose glamour items (not part of an outfit set) are stored with the game's own prism-box request command (the same request the Glamour Creation window's Yes button sends) instead of trying to open the outfit-store window, which the game only opens for set items. Each item costs one glamour prism (checked first) and the result reports "Stored item (dresser X->Y)". Outfit sets keep the existing flow. v1.3.0.3: Withdraw fix — the extractor was waiting on the dresser's 'requested' flag, which stays set while the data is loaded, so a run could stop before sending anything ("the dresser data stayed busy"); it now only gates on the loaded flag and retries refused sends. Store: the hand-in window is allowed to finish populating before the fill step decides nothing can be handed over. UI: two pages — Deposit (scan/store) and Withdraw (extractor) — with Abort reachable on the active page. v1.3.0.2: Gear-set protection hardening — items saved in a gear set are now detected from the saved gearset entries as well as the game's gear-set icon check (a 1.3.0.0 test scan saw 110 protected pieces on one pass and only 1 on another, so a piece could be misfiled as sortable). Deposit verification now reads the dresser list from MirageManager, so a dresser window that is momentarily unreadable no longer turns a successful deposit into a false "couldn't read the dresser" warning. v1.3.0.1: Fixes from the first 1.3.0.0 test. The dresser's "Add to pre-existing outfit glamour?" Yes/No prompt (shown when completing a stored outfit) is now answered automatically — before this it left the store flow stuck with the prompt on screen and froze the run. The Abort button stays clickable while a run is in progress. New watchdogs stop a set whose store window never opens or never produces its confirmation instead of stalling the rest of the run. Extractor: a refused RestorePrismBoxItem is retried (the client briefly refuses while a previous restore settles), waits for the dresser data request to finish, and skips further copies of a unique item (the game cannot give you a second copy while you hold one) instead of stopping the whole run; log lines now name the refused item. v1.3.0.0: Loose items — glamour-able items that belong to no outfit set are now stored as well, one at a time, and skipped when that item is already anywhere in the dresser. Extractor — withdraw dresser items back into your bags: all loose items, duplicates only (keeps one of each), or one item or item type such as all rings, with a live progress line. Item names and icons — planned pieces, duplicates and results now show the item icon, name and category instead of a raw item id. v1.2.0.1: Audit fixes. Completing an existing outfit works again — the pieces a stored outfit is still missing are planned as needed and are no longer listed as sellable duplicates. Deposit verification also accepts the planned pieces leaving your bags, so completing an outfit (or storing with a nearly full dresser) reports correctly instead of "No deposit detected". Store steps can no longer drop a set silently when a window does not open or the dresser closes mid-run, the store loop retries briefly while the dresser data reloads instead of stopping the rest of the run, and the Armoire toggle is locked while storing. /xllog now logs the scanned dresser/held counts for troubleshooting. v1.2.0.0: Full audit. Gear-set protection — pieces registered to a saved gear set are now left in your bags (the same check the game uses for its gear-set icon mark), instead of being pulled out of your gear sets. Smarter duplicates — stored outfit glamours are expanded into their pieces, so a second copy of an already-stored piece is flagged as sellable instead of being re-stored. The dresser's expanded item list is scanned, and a never-fill guard skips window slots the game already marks as part of the stored outfit. New model-duplicate hints show when a planned piece shares its appearance with something already stored. Deposit verification now retries briefly instead of failing on a single read. UI: version in the title, live progress tally while storing, MANUAL tag priority, gear-set and model-duplicate sections. Removed diagnostic logging. v1.1.1.0: The Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog is now automated (synthetic checkbox click + default-confirm callback); all sets route to the dresser. v1.1.0.0: Armoire routing added.
